recipe.name: apple-sweet-potato-puree
steps: Peel and dice the sweet potato.
Core and chop the apple.
Steam the sweet potato and apple until soft, about 15 minutes.
Blend with the water and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth.

servesEstimate.basis: 1 sweet potato and 1 apple: about 4 small portions.

recipe.name: baking-chocolate-cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F and grease two cake pans.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients.
In another bowl, beat the eggs, then add the buttermilk, oil, and vanilla.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and stir until just combined.
Stir in the hot coffee until the batter is smooth and pourable.
Divide the batter between the pans and bake for 30 minutes.

servesEstimate.basis: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 cups sugar, and 2 eggs: about 12 cake slices.

recipe.name: chewy-oat-cookies
steps: Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter with both sugars for 3 minutes, until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture, then the oats and raisins.
Cover the dough and chill it for at least 2 hours, or up to 3 days.
Heat the oven to 350F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Scoop the dough into 2-tablespoon balls and space them 2 inches apart.
Bake for 11 to 13 minutes, until golden at the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool on the sheets for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

servesEstimate.basis: 3 cups rolled oats, 1 cup raisins, and 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour: about 12 portions.

recipe.name: crispy-skin-salmon
steps: Score the skin of the salmon fillets and pat completely dry.
Season the skin generously with flaky sea salt.
Heat the neutral oil in a stainless pan until shimmering.
Lay the salmon skin-side down and press gently; cook until the skin is crisp.
Meanwhile, tear the little gem lettuce and thinly slice the watermelon radish.
Slice the avocado and arrange it with the greens.
Dress the salad with the dressing and finish with a squeeze of lemon.

servesEstimate.basis: 4 skin-on salmon fillets with 1 head little gem lettuce, 1 watermelon radish, and 1 avocado: 4 portions.

recipe.name: day-old-fried-rice
steps: Break up any clumps in the cold rice with your fingers.
Beat the eggs.
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a wok over high heat, scramble the eggs until just set, and tip them onto a plate.
Dice the carrot and the char siu, and thinly slice the green onions, keeping the whites and greens apart.
Mince the garlic.
Add the remaining oil to the wok, then the carrot and the green onion whites, and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and char siu and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and press it against the wok, tossing, for 3 minutes, until hot and starting to crisp.
Add the peas straight from the freezer and toss for 1 minute.
Season with the soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper, fold the eggs back in, and scatter over the green onion greens.

servesEstimate.basis: 3 cups cooked jasmine rice, 3 eggs, and 4 oz char siu or ham: about 3 portions.

recipe.name: indian-dal-tadka
steps: Rinse the toor dal and pressure cook with water and turmeric until soft.
Heat the ghee in a small pan for the tempering.
Temper the whole spices until they crackle and become fragrant.
Add the dried red chiles, garlic, and ginger, and saute until golden.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, then stir in the tomatoes and chili powder.
Pour the tempering into the cooked dal, add salt, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice.

servesEstimate.basis: 1 cup toor dal with 3 cups water, 1 onion, and 2 tomatoes: about 4 portions.

recipe.name: lime-shrimp-tacos
steps: Thinly slice the red onion and put it in a jar with the vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of the salt. Let it stand for 20 minutes.
Mince the garlic, zest and juice one lime, and cut the other into wedges.
Toss the shrimp with the lime zest and juice, the garlic, chili powder, half the oil, and the rest of the salt, and leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Slice the avocado.
Heat the remaining oil in a large skillet over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 minutes per side, until pink.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, shrimp, avocado, pickled onion, and cilantro, and serve with the lime wedges.

servesEstimate.basis: 1 lb shrimp and 8 corn tortillas: about 4 dinner portions.

recipe.name: multi-component-mole
steps: For the chicken: place the chicken thighs in a pot with the quartered onion and bay leaves, cover with water, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken and reserve the poaching liquid.
For the mole: toast the ancho, pasilla, and guajillo chiles in a dry skillet until fragrant, then soak in hot water.
In the same skillet, toast the sesame seeds, pumpkin seeds, and almonds.
Fry the tortillas and raisins until the tortillas are crisp.
Char the tomatoes, onion, and garlic under the broiler.
Blend the soaked chiles, toasted seeds, nuts, tortillas, raisins, charred vegetables, cinnamon, cloves, and cumin with some chicken broth into a smooth paste.
Heat the lard in a Dutch oven, fry the mole paste, then add the Mexican chocolate and remaining chicken broth.
Return the chicken to the pot, simmer in the mole for 20 minutes, and season with salt.

servesEstimate.basis: 6 bone-in chicken thighs: about 6 dinner portions.

ingredients.note: white onion 1/2: fractional bare count, kept as count 0.5

recipe.name: overnight-chickpea-stew
steps: The night before, cover the chickpeas with plenty of cold water and leave them to soak for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked chickpeas.
Dice the onion and carrot and slice the garlic.
Warm the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, and stock, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 1 hour, until the chickpeas are tender.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts and season with salt.

servesEstimate.basis: 1 cup dried chickpeas, 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes, and 4 cups vegetable stock: about 4 portions.

ingredients.note: unit 'can (14 oz)': one can; the 14 oz is the can's size, not an equivalent measure of the quantity

recipe.name: simple-weeknight-salmon
steps: Pat the salmon fillets dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and saute for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Place the salmon skin-side down and cook for 4 minutes per side.
Squeeze the lemon over the fish and garnish with parsley before serving.

recipe.name: spicy-harissa-pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the rigatoni until al dente.
Meanwhile, warm the harissa oil in a skillet and stir in the tomato paste.
Add the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant.
Add the heavy cream and a splash of pasta water, then toss in the drained rigatoni.
Remove from heat and stir in the Parmesan until melted.
Season with salt, garnish with torn basil, and serve.

servesEstimate.basis: 12 oz rigatoni with 3 tbsp harissa olive oil, 2 tbsp tomato paste, and 1/4 cup heavy cream: about 4 dinner portions.

recipe.name: sunday-roast-dinner
steps: The day before, pat the chicken dry, rub the flaky salt all over it, and refrigerate it uncovered overnight.
Take the chicken out of the fridge 1 hour before roasting.
Heat the oven to 220C (425F).
Peel the potatoes and cut them into large chunks.
Put the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, bring to a boil, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve the lemon and cut the head of garlic in half across the middle.
Stuff the lemon, garlic, and thyme into the chicken, rub it with the olive oil, and set it in a roasting pan.
Roast the chicken for 20 minutes.
While the chicken roasts, put the duck fat in a second roasting tin and heat it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Drain the potatoes, let them steam dry for 2 minutes, then shake them in the pot to rough up the edges.
Tip the potatoes into the hot fat, turn to coat, and add the rosemary.
Turn the oven down to 190C (375F) and roast the chicken and potatoes together for 50 minutes more, turning the potatoes once.
Trim the green beans.
Finely chop the shallot.
Check the chicken: the juices at the thigh should run clear, or a thermometer should read 74C (165F).
Lift the chicken onto a board and rest it, loosely covered, for 15 minutes.
Turn the oven up to 220C (425F) and give the potatoes a final 10 minutes to crisp.
Spoon off all but 1 tablespoon of fat from the chicken pan and set the pan over medium heat.
Add the shallot and cook for 2 minutes, then stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute more.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble, scraping up the browned bits, until almost gone.
Whisk in the stock and simmer for 5 minutes, until the gravy coats a spoon.
Meanwhile, boil the green beans in salted water for 5 minutes, then drain and toss with the butter.
Carve the chicken and serve with the potatoes, beans, and gravy.

servesEstimate.basis: 1 whole chicken (about 1.8 kg / 4 lb) with 1.2 kg (2 1/2 lb) floury potatoes and 300 g (10 oz) green beans: about 4 dinner portions.

ingredients.note: item text carries '(about 1.8 kg / 4 lb)' as a size description; the line's amount is a bare 1

recipe.name: weeknight-shakshuka
steps: Get everything ready first: thinly slice the onion, seed and slice the peppers, slice the garlic, and crush the tomatoes by hand in their can.
Warm the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat and cook the onion and peppers for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft and sweet.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, add the salt, and simmer for 10 minutes, until thickened.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook for 5 to 8 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Scatter the feta and parsley over the top and serve from the pan with bread.

servesEstimate.basis: 6 eggs in a sauce of 1 can (28 oz) whole tomatoes, 1 onion, and 2 red bell peppers: about 3 portions.

ingredients.note: unit 'can (28 oz)': one can; the 28 oz is the can's size, not an equivalent measure of the quantity

recipe.name: weeknight-stir-fry
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, fish sauce, chili oil, and cornstarch in a bowl to make the sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat.
Add the chicken and stir-fry until browned, then remove.
Add the bell pepper and snap peas and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and toss until fragrant.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce, and toss until glossy.
Drizzle with sesame oil, top with green onions, and serve.

servesEstimate.basis: 1 lb chicken thighs, 1 red bell pepper, and 1 cup snap peas: about 3 dinner portions.

recipe.name: yogurt-marinated-chicken
steps: Stir the yogurt, grated garlic, garam masala, turmeric, the juice of the lemon, and most of the salt together in a large bowl.
Slash each chicken thigh twice to the bone, add to the bowl, and turn to coat. Cover and marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 220C (425F) and line a roasting tray with foil.
Lay the chicken skin-side up on the tray, drizzle with the oil, and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until charred at the edges.
While the chicken roasts, grate the cucumber and squeeze out the liquid.
Finely chop the mint and stir it into the Greek yogurt with the cucumber and the rest of the salt.
Slice the red onion into thin rings.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then serve with the raita and onion.

servesEstimate.basis: 8 bone-in chicken thighs: about 4 dinner portions.

recipe.name: Sweet Zucchini Wraps
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic scape and zucchini with a pinch of cumin until sweet and caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Stir in the onion greens at the very end.
Fry the parathas in a dry skillet until crisp and flaky.
Stuff the hot wrappers with the spiced zucchini.
Add a drizzle of chili oil or Calabrian chile for anyone who wants heat.

servesEstimate.basis: 2 zucchini, 1 onion bulb, 1 garlic scape, and frozen parathas: about 2 portions.
3 tbsp flaky sea salt, 2 sprigs rosemary, and 1 lemon: about 24 condiment portions.

ingredients.note: no unit field; 'sprigs' is the first word of the item text, so a bare count of 2
